build_mlp_head: build a multi-layer perceptron transformer head with configurable pooler and classification layers for MMF models
create_mlp_config: create an MLP head config with custom num_labels, hidden_size, dropout, and pooler name settings
run_mlp_forward: run the MLP forward pass on a sequence output tensor to get classification scores
review_mlp_get_pooler: review the MLP get_pooler method to support bert_pooler, identity, or custom layer poolers
refactor_prediction_head_transform: refactor the PredictionHeadTransformWithInDim class to use a custom input dimension for the dense layer
